reviews.body: Found one P2 test-coverage gap in the search endpoint. All 9 existing tests and typechecking pass.

comments.body:
🟡 **P2** · 🐛 **Bug**

The new endpoint behavior has no test coverage: `test/search.test.ts` only checks the string returned by `containsPattern`. Those tests still pass if either search branch is removed or the count query stops applying the filter. Add endpoint tests with database fixtures covering case-insensitive partial matches on both fields, literal wildcard matching, combined filters, and a multi-page result whose `total` stays consistent.
